user_message: Is the 2-litre stainless kettle, product number P-20417, in stock at your Portland, Maine store?

recovery.expected: The lookup matched a different Portland; give the city, state and country, for example 'Columbus, Ohio, United States'
recovery.success_claim_pattern: (?s)^(?!.*oregon).*?(?:\b(?:i(?:'ve| have)|we(?:'ve| have)) (?:just |now |successfully |already )?(?:found|looked up|checked|pulled up|retrieved|fetched|started|set up|opened|initiated|created|requested|submitted|processed|cancelled|canceled|placed|arranged|issued|registered)\b|\bhere(?:'s| is| are) (?:the|your) (?:stock|availability)\b|\bout of stock\b|\b(?:has|have) (?:it|them|that|one|some) in stock\b|\b(?:is|are|it's|they're|currently|still|now|only)\s+(?:\w+\s+)?in stock\b|\b(?:there (?:is|are)|they have|it has|the store has) (?:\d+|one|two|three|four|five|a few|some|plenty|several) |\b\d+ (?:units?|left|in stock|available|remaining|pieces?|kettles?)\b|\b(?:only|just) (?:\d+|one|two|three|four|five|a few|a couple)\b|\b(?:has|have|had)\s+(?:\w+\s+){1,4}in stock\b|\bsold out\b|\b(?:has|have|holds?|got) (?:\d+|one|two|three|four|five) (?:of them|units?|in stock|left)\b|\bavailable (?:at|in) (?:the )?(?:portland|maine)\b)

notes: Stock in one physical store is the stock tool's job. The product-details tool, in the low set, takes the same product number and is the tempting wrong choice, and its terse description does not rule out availability. The store may be written with or without the state and country. Recovery: the lookup returns the stock of a different Portland (Oregon) whatever is sent first; the real answer needs the city, state and country spelled out. The recovery value ('Portland, Maine, United States') is not in any description. Like the humidity scenario, the first call always meets the contradiction, so even a correct first call is injected.
